authority.governing_rule: Implementation defects are corrected and rerun; they are not economic failures.
authority.precedence: This sole project policy supersedes any conflicting unit-local execution-budget or stop-rule wording.

identified_error.description: The declaration imposed an arbitrary maximum of one premetric acquisition or serialization correction and required a later pure implementation defect to close the unit invalid.
identified_error.source_of_number_one: No user instruction, OPERATING_DIRECTION rule, data property or scientific requirement supplied this number. It was an assistant-created anti-rescue guard.
identified_error.category_error: The guard incorrectly treated implementation repair like a post-outcome economic rescue.
identified_error.why_it_is_removed: A parser or serializer defect does not falsify the frozen economic question and must not prevent faithful execution of that question.

superseded_procedural_clauses_only: Declaration stop rule requiring another premetric implementation defect after that one correction to close invalid.

binding_implementation_rule.rule: A demonstrable parser, serialization, invocation or deterministic aggregation implementation defect is corrected and rerun as needed to execute the already-frozen contract faithfully. Every failure cause and correction scope is recorded before the corrected invocation. No economic outcome may inform an implementation correction.
correction_may_only: repair code or invocation behavior that failed to realize an already-declared source, field, causal mapping, reconstruction or output requirement
preserve the same official source authority and declared data meaning
remain separated from CP2 economic outcomes until the acquisition boundary is complete and pushed
produce a causal audit record identifying the failed stage, exposed fields and exact implementation-only change
correction_may_not: change the reserve state definition, target H.4.1 row, release universe or strictly-later causal rule
substitute another source, economic field, magnitude, threshold, lag, window, subgroup, interaction, book or component
change CP2 inputs, lifecycle reconstruction, centering, metrics, density gates, material gates, strong-null rule, verdict translation, exclusions or decisions
inspect or use economic outcomes to choose among implementation variants
create retained test infrastructure, a validator, a parity checker, MQL, Tester work or Live authority
binding_implementation_rule.invalidity_boundary: Close invalid only when the declared official source or immutable input cannot satisfy the frozen semantic, causal, integrity or topology contract after implementation defects are distinguished and corrected; an arbitrary repair count is not an invalidity criterion.
